test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

We have to go / under the books if / we want to pass / the board exams this year.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Under the books if"** is not a grammatically correct phrase. 
 
• It seems like there is a missing word or phrase that should come after** "under."**
 
• The correct preposition to use in this context would be "**through**".
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **'**through **the books if.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is - **'Option 4.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1:** "we want to pass"** is a grammatically correct phrase.
 
• Option 2: **"We have to go" **is a grammatically correct phrase.
 
• Option 3: **"the board exams this year"** is a grammatically correct phrase.
